The '''Aldraig system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aldraig IV]].
